plan.goal: Autonomously explore and critique the UX of the GreenGrove pet insurance system, focusing on the 6-step quote wizard's usability, accessibility, and error handling, while validating adjacent support pages (Claims, FAQ) and mobile responsiveness.
plan.summary: The run will begin by auditing the landing page for layout issues and navigation entry points. It will then execute a comprehensive walkthrough of the 6-step quote wizard, testing complex interactions like the breed combobox, condition chips, and tier comparison logic. Finally, it will validate the Claims form and FAQ accordion before repeating critical path checks on a mobile viewport to address known tap-target risks.
assumptions: The 'Sign in' link is a placeholder (#) and does not lead to a functional authentication flow.
The quote wizard relies on client-side state management (JS) rather than server round-trips for step transitions.
The 'Breed' dropdown uses a custom ARIA combobox implementation requiring specific keyboard interaction patterns.
risk_hotspots: quote.html: Step 2 Breed selection (ARIA combobox keyboard navigation)
quote.html: Step 4 Pre-existing conditions (multi-select chip logic & 'None' toggle conflict)
quote.html: Step 5 Tier comparison (collapsible table visibility & live price updates)
Global: Navigation tap targets (identified as <44px in prescan)

phases.title: Landing Page & Navigation Audit
phases.objective: Validate entry points, visual hierarchy, and identify immediate layout/accessibility blockers.
key_checks: Verify 'Start a free quote' CTA leads to quote.html
Check 'See the FAQ' deep link scrolls or navigates correctly
Document small tap target warnings in header nav
Verify responsive behavior of hero illustration and value props

phases.title: Quote Wizard: Input & Logic (Steps 1-3)
phases.objective: Test the initial data capture flow, focusing on the complex breed selector and age inputs.
key_checks: Step 1: Verify pet type icons are selectable and update state
Step 2: Test Breed combobox with keyboard (Up/Down/Enter/Esc) and mouse
Step 2: Verify auto-switch logic when changing species (e.g., Dog to Cat)
Step 3: Validate Age stepper bounds and year/month toggle functionality
Test 'Back' button persistence of data from Step 3 to Step 1
exit_criteria: Successfully reach Step 4 with valid data
Data persistence confirmed on backward navigation

phases.title: Quote Wizard: Selection & Pricing (Steps 4-6)
phases.objective: Validate complex selection states, pricing calculations, and final summary accuracy.
key_checks: Step 4: Test multi-select chips for conditions
Step 4: Verify 'None' toggle clears other selections
Step 5: Compare Sprout/Sapling/Oak tiers
Step 5: Check collapsible side-by-side comparison table
Step 5: Verify deductible dropdown affects monthly/annual totals
Step 6: Validate final summary matches previous inputs
exit_criteria: Pricing logic appears consistent with inputs
All wizard steps accessible via top dot indicator

phases.title: Support Pages & Recovery Flows
phases.objective: Ensure users can access help and file claims without breaking the primary flow context.
key_checks: FAQ: Expand/collapse all 12 accordion items
FAQ: Check for content overflow in long answers
Claims: Validate form field labels and required states
Claims: Test file upload input (visual feedback only)
Verify global nav links work from these sub-pages
exit_criteria: No dead ends from support pages

phases.title: Mobile Viewport Validation
phases.objective: Repeat critical checks on mobile to address prescan tap-target warnings and layout shifts.
key_checks: Re-test header nav tap targets (expect failures based on prescan)
Verify Quote Wizard steps stack vertically without horizontal scroll
Test Breed combobox overlay on small screens
Verify Tier cards are readable and selectable on narrow viewports
exit_criteria: Critical path (Quote) usable on mobile despite layout warnings

coverage_targets.pages: Visit all 4 HTML files (index, quote, claims, faq)
coverage_targets.features: Exercise all 6 steps of the quote wizard, including edge cases in breed selection and condition toggles
coverage_targets.mobile: Repeat Phase 1 and Phase 2 key checks on mobile viewport

notes: Prescan indicates significant tap target issues (<44px) in the global navigation; prioritize documenting these as high-severity mobile UX flaws.
The 'Sign in' link appears non-functional; verify if it shows an error or does nothing.
Pay close attention to the 'Breed' combobox accessibility attributes during Phase 2.
